summary: This note describes Podolsky District, an administrative and municipal district (raion) in Moscow Oblast, Russia. It is one of the thirty-six raions in the oblast and lies in its southwest, just south of the federal city of Moscow. Its administrative center is the city of Podolsk, which is not administratively part of the district. The note reports a 2010 Census population of 82,488.
one_line: Podolsky District is a raion in southwestern Moscow Oblast, Russia, administered from the city of Podolsk.
key_facts: Podolsky District is an administrative and municipal district (raion) in Moscow Oblast, Russia.
Podolsky District is one of the thirty-six raions in Moscow Oblast.
Podolsky District is located in the southwest of Moscow Oblast.
Podolsky District lies just south of the federal city of Moscow.
The administrative center of Podolsky District is the city of Podolsk.
Podolsk is not administratively a part of Podolsky District.
The population of Podolsky District was 82,488 at the 2010 Census.
